items.definition:
the action of helping someone
Thank you for your assistance.

the action of delivering letters, parcels, or goods
The package is out for delivery.

people in general
Some folk prefer to live in the countryside.

the state of being male or female
Please indicate your gender on the form.

an example or single occurrence of something
For instance, consider the case of climate change.

movement
The car's motion made me feel sick.

a statement or event that indicates a possible danger or problem
The weather forecast issued a warning for strong winds.

a settled way of thinking or feeling about something
She has a very positive attitude towards life.

a period of ten years
The company has grown significantly over the last decade.

a statement of the exact meaning of a word or phrase
Can you give me the definition of that word?

an act of kindness; approval
Could you do me a favor and help me move this box?

a rigid structure that surrounds or encloses something
She put the picture in a beautiful wooden frame.

a quantity of something carried or supported
The truck was carrying a heavy load of timber.

the main events of a play, novel, or movie; a small piece of ground
The plot of the movie was very exciting.

a thing that may happen or be the case
There's a possibility of rain later today.

a small piece of advice or a small sum of money given for a service
He gave me a useful tip for cooking.

a number of things, typically of the same kind, growing or fastened together
She bought a bunch of flowers.

a class or division of people or things
This book belongs to the fiction category.

the kinds of food that a person, animal, or community habitually eats
He changed his diet to eat healthier.

a narrow road or path
Stay in your lane while driving.

a state of disorder or untidiness
Your room is a complete mess.

a feeling of happy satisfaction and enjoyment
It was a pleasure to meet you.

program
The television programme starts at 8 PM.

change, work period
I work the night shift this week.

keeping, repository
We need more storage space in the kitchen.

transport
Public transportation is very efficient here.

buyer, user
Consumers are demanding more eco-friendly products.

act of creating, something created
The creation of new jobs is essential for the economy.

work, job
The company offers good employment opportunities.

reason, justification
He had no excuse for being late.

specialist, master
She is an expert in ancient history.

significance, value
The importance of education cannot be overstated.

staff; employees
All personnel are required to attend the meeting.

a series of contests between a number of competitors
Our team won the football tournament last year.

a person harmed, injured, or killed as a result of a crime, accident, or other event or action
The police are helping the victims of the flood.

the distance from the top or surface to the bottom
The lake has a depth of 10 meters.

the fact or state of living or having objective reality
Do you believe in the existence of aliens?

the process of making known one's thoughts or feelings
Her face showed an expression of surprise.

way; style
She spoke in a calm manner.

friend; partner
My old school mate came to visit.

source; beginning
What is the origin of this tradition?

a flat section; a group of experts
The solar panel converts sunlight into electricity.

character; individual nature
She has a very strong personality.

a feeling of embarrassment; a pity
It's a shame you can't come to the party.

the activity of promoting products
The company spends a lot on advertising.

a strong wire; a system for TV
We need a new cable for the internet.

a customer; a person receiving services
Our company has many international clients.

a person active in party politics
The politician gave a speech about the economy.

the ability to see; something that is seen
Her sight is very good.

the date on which an event took place in a previous year
We celebrated our tenth wedding anniversary.

an event in which people compete
She won the singing contest.

a payment made to a professional person or to a professional or public body in exchange for advice or services
There is an entrance fee for the museum.

a machine that produces motion or power
The car's motor needs to be repaired.

a part of a larger whole
She ate a small portion of cake.

the period of your life after you have stopped working
She is looking forward to her retirement next year.

a small amount of something that shows you what the rest is like
Can I have a sample of the new perfume?

a pleasant situation or event that you imagine but that is unlikely to happen
He often escapes into a world of fantasy.

the action of introducing something or someone; the opening part of a book or speech
The introduction to the book was very informative.

an official document giving you permission to do something
You need a license to drive a car.

the transport of goods
The shipping cost was higher than expected.

hot gas produced by boiling water
Steam rose from the hot cup of tea.

the grounds and buildings of a university
The university campus is very beautiful.

the act of comparing two or more things
There's no comparison between the two products.

a person who designs, builds, or maintains engines, machines, or structures
My sister is a software engineer.
